product.olivetti-pcs-d4-100-n.summary: The DX4 PCS in this platform’s Slim Tin Box case.
product.olivetti-pcs-d4-100-n.history: Olivetti documented the PCS D4/100 as the PCS counterpart on the M4-5x4 platform. This configuration used the Slim Tin Box case.
product.olivetti-pcs-d4-100-n.architectu: The cache helps identify the PCS configuration. The guide lists 128 KB of L2 cache and onboard Trident TGUI9440 AGi graphics.
product.olivetti-pcs-d4-100-n.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-pcs-d4-100-n.limitation: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-pcs-d4-100-n.service-gu: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, vol. II, ch. 13
product.olivetti-pcs-d4-100-n.firmware: The revision helps identify the service BIOS. The guide lists 1.25 · Update 1.
